name: whats-allowed-mcp
description: What your coding agent can do without asking you.
long_description: Reads every settings file that contributes permission rules — managed policy, project, local, user — and reports the merged picture: which file each rule came from, which defaultMode wins, what proceeds unattended, and which rules the client accepts and then ignores (path rules on Write/Glob, param rules on primary content fields, unanchored allow globs, /path rules in user settings that anchor at the config directory, allow rules a deny rule reaches first). Read-only by construction: no child processes, no network, no writes. Values of env entries are never read, only their names.
